messages:
Maya: FYI, customer 'AtlasAI' reporting 502s from hosted API (eu-west) starting ~2025-11-07T12:03Z after a large embedding batch. Ticket INC-4321.

Ops-bot: alert: gateway-502-rate increased to 78% (1m) in eu-west - https://metrics/redwood/eu-west :rotating_light:

Devon: can you paste a minimal repro and trace id?

Maya: minimal curl sample below (sensitive parts redacted). trace=trc-eu-98765
```
curl -v https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: atlasai" \
  -H "X-Tenant-Meta: <large-json-metadata>" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large-1","input":["...lots of texts..."]}'
```
Errors are 502 gateway, not 4xx.

Liam: I'm seeing envoy upstream resets for trc-eu-98765. Short log excerpt: `upstream_reset_after_response` and `resource_exhausted: connection pool`. Looks like h2 conn/stream pressure.

Sam: sounds like h2 pool starvation + too many long-lived streams (keepalive + streaming chunks). Are they using concurrent streaming for multiple embed requests?

Maya: yes — customer ramped concurrency to ~30 clients each opening 8 streams. Started failing when sustained concurrency > ~180 streams.

Katie: temporary mitigation options: 1) apply per-tenant concurrency cap on frontdoor for atlasai, 2) reduce keepalive timeout on edge to force connection churn earlier, 3) enable model fallback to smaller embed model to reduce per-request duration.

Devon: I can push a temp rate-limit rule (tenant-concurrency=10) — it's their test workspace so SLA impact minimal. Will notify.

Sam: please also capture envoy stats + nginx connection counts for correlation. Commands: `kubectl -n edge exec -c proxy envoy -- stats | grep upstream_cx_active` and `ss -s` on the host. We need pool_capacity trends.

Maya: applied rate-limit rl-789 at 12:06Z. Customer reports error rate dropped immediately. Keeping rule on while we triage.

Liam: uploaded logs + tcpdump. Key snippet:
```
[2025-11-07T12:04:18Z] proxy eu-west envoy [warning] upstream_reset_after_response: stream id=158 trace=trc-eu-98765 pool_capacity=0
[2025-11-07T12:04:18Z] proxy eu-west envoy [error] Resource exhausted: h2 max_concurrent_streams reached for upstream 10.0.32.7
```
Indicates upstream refused additional streams; connection pool drained.

Devon: opening eng ticket and assigning to eng-runtime/edge-sre to evaluate dynamic pool resizing or tenant isolation (sharding).

Sam: created ENG-2314 (edge: investigate h2 connpool exhaustion & tenant isolation) and linked INC-4321. Tagging runtime and eng-sre.

Katie: action list: 1) keep rl-789 in place until fix (owner: Devon), 2) collect full frontdoor + envoy config and keepalive/timeouts (owner: Liam), 3) run controlled load test with fallback to smaller model to validate reduced stream durations (owner: Maya), 4) eng-runtime to propose long-term isolation/sharding (owner: Sam).

Maya: noted. I'll update customer and ask them to keep reduced concurrency while we work. Will paste any additional traces as they come. :thumbsup:

Ops-bot: Incident annotation: ENG-2314 linked to INC-4321 by Maya at 2025-11-07T12:10Z.

Devon: next steps for ENG-2314 — collect per-host pool metrics, reproduce with a synthetic tenant hitting identical header sizes, and test changing upstream keepalive/concurrency knobs. I'll coordinate infra windows.

Liam: I'll upload the collected metrics dashboard and the pcap to the ticket.

Sam: thanks all — moving to active investigation. If anyone sees a second spike, escalate to #eng-sre and drop the trace IDs here.

Maya: will do. Closing loop with AtlasAI now.
